tools.name: calculate_max_rent
tools.description: Maximum LIHTC gross rent and tenant-paid rent for one unit: county, bedroom count and AMI level, less an optional utility allowance, from HUD FY2026 MTSP limits by the IRS Publication 5913 method, with the formula.

tools.name: check_qct_dda
tools.description: Is a site in a Qualified Census Tract or Difficult Development Area on HUD's 2027 lists (and any newer year HUD has posted)? Give a US street address (geocoded by the Census Bureau), or lat + lon, or an 11-digit 2020 census tract. Returns the tract, county, ZCTA and metro area and one result per lis

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: HUD-listed LIHTC properties still monitored for compliance, in one state, optionally one city and a name or street fragment, largest first. Each result has its lihtc.loans page URL and HUD project id for get_property. Covers cities with 5 or more monitored properties.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Everything HUD's LIHTC database lists for one property (units, income-restricted units, bedrooms, placed-in-service and allocation years, credit type, bonds, income test, targeting), its compliance and extended-use years, 2027 QCT/DDA status, its county's 2026 50% and 60% limits and rents, and nearb

tools.name: get_state_lihtc
tools.description: One state's allocating agency and LIHTC page, current Qualified Allocation Plan, state credit, 2026 9% credit ceiling and private activity bond cap (with the per-capita or minimum basis and population), and its count of 2027 QCTs and nonmetro DDA counties.

tools.name: get_applicable_percentages
tools.description: The monthly 70% (9%) and 30% (4%) present value credit rates from the IRS revenue ruling, the statutory 9% and 4% floors and the rate a deal uses. Defaults to the latest month, with the last 12.

tools.name: get_equity_pricing
tools.description: Median net equity price per $1 of federal housing credit from CohnReznick's Housing Tax Credit Monitor, the series since late 2024, and current national fund pricing ranges.

tools.name: calculate_credits
tools.description: Annual and 10-year housing credits and equity from eligible basis, applicable fraction, credit type (4 or 9), the optional 130% basis boost and a credit price (default: the latest public median). tools.name: get_financing_quote_link
tools.description: The page where a developer or owner can request a financing quote for a 4% or 9% deal (construction, tax-exempt bond, bridge, permanent, Year 15) from Janover Capital LLC, and what the desk handles. Returns a link only; it submits nothing.
